item.text: I’ll inspect the test module and its surrounding context, then call out only concrete issues.

This module provides small order helpers: totals item prices × quantities, applies `SAVE10`/`SAVE20` discounts, computes an average, and formats an order receipt.

Bugs in [test/orders.js](C:\Users\Kerim\AppData\Local\Temp\codex-eco-bench-qxBr6w\test\orders.js):

- `calcTotal` loops with `i <= items.length`; at the final iteration `items[i]` is `undefined`, causing a `TypeError`. It should use `i < items.length`.
- Consequently, `formatOrder` and `averageItemPrice` also fail whenever they call `calcTotal`.
- `averageItemPrice` divides by `items.length`, so an empty array yields `NaN`/`Infinity` behavior (once the loop bug is fixed).
- Its name is potentially misleading: it returns average line total (including quantity), not average unit `price`.
